source.title: RTL public ferry terminal catalogue
source.coverage: Atoll-prefixed terminal label positions; not national journey coverage
source.license_status: Public operator endpoint; explicit reuse licence not stated

join_policy.method: Unique containing island polygon, otherwise exactly one island within 150 m of its polygon. Nearby alternatives are retained. Terminal names are preserved; joins use geography rather than name-only matching.
join_policy.distance_method: Local spherical equirectangular projection at each terminal latitude, Earth radius 6371000 m; distances are approximations, not surveyed measurements.
join_policy.ambiguous_policy: Multiple containing polygons or multiple coastal candidates without a unique containing polygon remain unassigned.

limitations: Operator-listed terminal coordinates are infrastructure evidence, not a sailing timetable, service availability, landing permission or berth-suitability certificate.
Catalogue retrieval is dated 11 October 2026; subsequent changes are not observed.
The source catalogue covers atoll-prefixed terminals and omits Greater Male terminals; those require separately identified mapped evidence.
A physical-island join does not change or validate the operator terminal label.
No port, jetty or terminal construction is inferred or costed by using this catalogue.
